incidents.title: LLMjacking: stolen cloud credentials used to hijack hosted Claude and other LLM services
incidents.targets: Cloud accounts with exposed credentials (Laravel CVE-2021-3129 entry), victims billed up to $100,000 per day
incidents.outcome: Victims faced LLM consumption costs Sysdig estimated at up to $100,000 a day.
incidents.confidenceReason: Sysdig, which investigated the intrusions and named LLMjacking, states what the stolen access was used for; its own report is cited.
incidents.summary: Attackers used cloud credentials stolen through a vulnerable Laravel system to abuse hosted LLM services on victims' accounts, including Claude on AWS Bedrock, and resold the access through reverse proxies.
incidents.quote: Attackers reportedly exploited stolen cloud credentials obtained through a vulnerable Laravel system (CVE-2021-3129) to allegedly abuse AI cloud services, including Anthropic’s Claude and AWS Bedrock, in a scheme referred to as “LLMjacking.”
incidents.singleSourceReason: Only Sysdig has reported this operation among the sources found in the 2026-11-17 sweep, which AI Incident Database restates.

incidents.title: WiseTech Global CEO deepfaked in multiple WhatsApp attempts to scam staff
incidents.outcome: Staff recognized the attempts; no loss reported.
incidents.confidenceReason: WiseTech described the attempts; it reaches us through the AI Incident Database.
incidents.summary: Actors used AI to make videos of WiseTech Global CEO Richard White asking staff for money in several WhatsApp attempts.
incidents.quote: WiseTech Global's CEO, Richard White, was targeted in multiple deepfake scam attempts where unknown actors used AI to create videos of him requesting money from staff members via WhatsApp.
incidents.singleSourceReason: This operation reaches the ledger only through AI Incident Database's record; the 2026-11-17 sweep found no other publisher.

incidents.title: WPP CEO impersonated with voice clone in fake Teams meeting
incidents.outcome: Attempt failed; no money lost per reporting.
incidents.confidenceReason: The CEO's email to staff, quoted by the Guardian, is a first-hand account with specifics (a fake WhatsApp account, a Teams meeting, a voice clone and YouTube footage), but no evidence is shown. Read's only verbatim AI line is "We all need to be vigilant to the techniques that go beyond emails to take advantage of virtual meetings, AI and deepfakes."
incidents.summary: Fraudsters set up a fake WhatsApp account with Mark Read's photo and a virtual meeting using a voice clone and YouTube footage to solicit money and details from an agency leader. Staff recognised the attempt.
incidents.quote: fraudsters impersonated WPP's CEO using a fake WhatsApp account, a voice clone and YouTube footage
incidents.singleSourceReason: Only The Guardian has reported this operation among the sources found in the 2026-11-17 sweep.
